liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-18.sbd.miller.79117.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 148 min; rated 3.43/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: U.S. Blues audio quality is noticeably worse, likely originating from an audience source [10]
- **gd94-03-18.aud.braverman.13930.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 145 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds like a pocket tape recorder with heavy audience chat and distant band audio; Listener notes the recording matches typical Rosemont Horizon audience tape quality; Uploader describes the recording as rather poor, noting it is the only available source [2][4][5]
- **gd1994-03-18.140067.fob-akg451.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 17 songs; 147 min [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls their first Dead show in 1987 and a 1980 Billy Joel concert at the venue [8]
- Several audience members appeared alarmed by the early placement of the song Deal [9]
- The Stranger opener received significant applause from the crowd [12]
- Reviewer states this performance was a primary catalyst for their appreciation of the band [7]
- Brown Eyed Women was the shortest version the reviewer has ever heard [10]
- Show lacked previous intensity but featured intricate details showing individual and collective musical growth [11]
- This finale was the weakest of the three-night run, though still enjoyable overall [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-18.sbd.miller.79117.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd94-03-18.aud.braverman.13930.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Rick Martin, Chris Ladner, Peter Braverman; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [2]. Also: Reviewer mentions possessing a DAT SBD copy intended for future circulation or download [6]
- **gd1994-03-18.140067.fob-akg451.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44 Source Info:FOB AKG 451 -> Koro P/S-> Panasonic SV255-> DATTransfer Info:DAT (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Coxial SPDIF-> Marantz PMD 661 MKII (Solid State… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-03-16 Rosemont Horizon, Rosemont, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-03-16-rosemont-horizon-rosemont-il-usa/) [15]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-03-18 Rosemont Horizon, Rosemont, IL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-03-18-rosemont-horizon-rosemont-il-usa/) [16]
